title: Component Structure — react-data-table-component
instructions:
## Purpose

Examine how react-data-table-component assembles its table: DataTableInner provides every context and renders the responsive wrapper chain down to Table, Head, and Body, while feature components (ColumnFilter, ContextMenu, ExpanderButton, Pagination) receive values through supplied props instead of direct imports.

## Regeneration

Clone https://github.com/jbetancur/react-data-table-component.git, then from its root:

```sh
npm install
node "<generator-directory>/run.js" \
  --base "." \
  --root "DataTableInner" \
  "src"
```

Only the dependency install is needed; the analysis reads the library sources directly, not the built dist. The root is DataTableInner, the implementation behind the React.forwardRef export, because the wrapper itself resolves to a React API boundary rather than a component definition.
